_comment: Recorded FDIC national average response for 5-year CD rates. In production, the FDIC publishes 'National Rates and Rate Caps' weekly. This fixture represents a scraped/exported snapshot. If the live FDIC adapter fails (e.g. 500 error or HTML structure change), the orchestrator falls back to the most recent snapshot under data-pipeline/snapshots/ and records a degraded status — the run continues, but REVIEW.md flags it.
_note: This is the FDIC 'national average' (all FDIC-insured institutions, deposit-weighted). The pipeline uses it as a floor comparison benchmark, not a top-rate quote — retail MYGA rates substantially exceed this in Phase 4's environment. Value is in percent; adapter converts to decimal (0.0185).
